subject: You were BORN for more
body:
Most people will ignore this email. That's why most people are broke.

My course EMPIRE is 200 DOLR. For you, today only, 20 DOLR. Reply EMPIRE to claim it.

outcomes.when: the player replies EMPIRE, or says they want, buy or sign up for the course
outcomes.reply:
That's the decision most people never make.

Secure your seat here: empire.alphaascend.biz

The 20 DOLR price is good until midnight. After that it goes back to 200, as it has every midnight since launch.

Max

hints: It costs 20 DOLR. Reply only if you want in.
